Toggle UI hotkey
Global key that opens/closes this panel. Reserved and not editable as a regular key.
MCM key picker
When an MCM asks you to press a key, this panel opens over it. Click a key (on any layer) to bind it, then name and colour it. Pressing a real key still binds it straight away; ESC goes back to the MCM's own prompt. SKSE menu pages: click the page's "press a key" button, then press this panel's toggle key.
Mod keys from config files
Reads mods' hotkeys from their settings files (MCM Helper menus, SKSE plugin ini / json) when the game starts and when this panel opens. Files are only read, never changed. Classic MCM keys still appear once you bind them in the MCM. Right-click a key to mark one that only works inside its own menu, or to remove it.
Not scanned yet.
Label font
Any font installed on your PC, for your key and mouse labels. Menus and settings keep a plain font so they stay easy to read.
Key colours
Fill: the whole key takes its colour. Dot: keys stay plain and show their colour as a dot in the corner (more even, and leaves room for icons).
Key icons
Keys with an icon (right-click a key > Icon and border) show it above their name, or the icon alone. The info box always names the key.
Label font size
Size of your custom key and mouse labels (in pixels). Other UI text stays fixed.
18
Panel place and size
Drag the title "Hotkey Panel" in the top-right corner to move the panel; drag the grip in the bottom-right corner to resize it. Double-click the grip (or Reset) for the default size and place.
Panel transparency
Opacity of the whole panel. 100% = solid; lower = see-through.
100%
Tablet / phone remote
Open this panel in the web browser of a tablet or phone on your home network. Tapping a labelled key there fires it in game; a long press is the key's menu. Edits sync both ways. The first time, Windows may ask to let Skyrim through the firewall.
Off.
